baseline.source_live_copy_library_status: historical source copy removed after byte-identical SHA verification; canonical bytes remain in MysteryLogic-FINAL-BASE-2026-09-25.zip

verification.scope: Current production including the final Detective IQ S1 multistep replacement
verification.canonicalization_note: MysteryLogic-FINAL-BASE-2026-09-25.zip is byte-identical to the owner-verified MysteryLogic-LIVE-2026-09-25.zip and is the mandatory base for all subsequent production changes.

rules.mandatory_base: Every future Mystery Logic chat/agent must read CURRENT_RELEASE.json first and use this exact baseline for production work unless CURRENT_RELEASE.json has been replaced by a newer canonical baseline.
rules.no_old_bases: Do not use MysteryLogic-LIVE-2026-09-23.zip, earlier IQ candidates, previous S1 patches, GitHub main snapshots, or Actions artifacts as a substitute for this baseline.
rules.pre_change_check: Before changing the site, inspect current mysterylogic.com for concurrent live changes and compare them against this canonical baseline.
rules.github_actions_artifacts: Never treat a GitHub Actions artifact as the production baseline unless CURRENT_RELEASE.json explicitly points to it.
rules.small_changes: Prefer a minimal patch containing only changed production files, built over this exact baseline.
rules.promotion: A newer baseline becomes canonical only after deploy -> live verification -> owner confirmation -> save verified full LIVE baseline -> update CURRENT_RELEASE.json.
rules.versioning: Do not invent semantic version numbers. Use only explicit release identifiers or dates.
rules.pending_candidate: A pending_final_candidate may be the frozen approved next build without being LIVE. Do not call it LIVE or replace the canonical baseline until promotion conditions are met.

pending_final_candidate.deployment_blocker: GitHub Actions repository secrets BEGET_HOST, BEGET_USER, BEGET_PASSWORD are absent; controlled deploy stopped before backup/rsync.
pending_final_candidate.continuity_rule: All chats continuing the already-approved pending release must use this exact candidate. For claims about current LIVE, the canonical baseline above remains authoritative until promotion.
